articles.summary: Alibaba's chip subsidiary T-Head (平头哥) has officially filed an IPO application, confirming long-rumored plans to go public. This marks a significant step in China's push to develop domestic semiconductor capabilities independent of Western supply chains.

articles.title: A Startup Wants to Fight AI Bioweapons With AI
articles.summary: Startup Radical Numerics has developed an offline AI model capable of identifying both natural and AI-engineered pathogens, positioning it as a biosecurity tool against AI-generated bioweapons. The technology addresses a critical and emerging safety concern as generative AI lowers barriers to designing dangerous biological agents.

articles.title: Google DeepMind just mathematically verified key parts of Signal
articles.summary: Google DeepMind completed a four-week project to mathematically verify key components of the Signal encrypted messaging protocol using AI-assisted formal verification. The effort suggests AI could make formal software verification—historically expensive and slow—significantly more practical, with major implications for software security.

articles.title: UK chip start-up Fractile hits $7bn valuation
articles.summary: UK-based chip startup Fractile has reached a $7 billion valuation as it develops custom semiconductors designed specifically for AI workloads. The milestone underscores the growing investor interest in alternatives to Nvidia's GPU dominance, particularly from European startups.

articles.title: Meta is losing its longtime head of  infrastructure
articles.summary: Santosh Janardhan, Meta's longtime head of infrastructure who joined the company in 2009, is stepping down from his role. His departure is notable given Meta's massive ongoing investment in AI infrastructure and data centers.

articles.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
articles.summary: CoreWeave is restructuring its financing by requiring customer prepayments, borrowing against individual contracts, and offering shorter-term deals at higher prices to fund its AI cloud growth. The strategy reveals the financial pressures facing AI infrastructure companies trying to scale rapidly amid capital-intensive GPU deployments.

articles.title: Congress to call Jensen Huang in to answer for alleged Chinese spy affair
articles.summary: House Republicans are calling Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for a closed-door briefing regarding his relationship with a woman alleged to be a Chinese intelligence operative, with a deadline set for Wednesday. The congressional inquiry signals that the affair is being treated as a potential national security concern given Huang's central role in global AI chip supply.

articles.title: Trump Officials Clashed Over Megaspeed, Firm at Heart of Nvidia Affair
articles.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick clashed over why the administration failed to restrict advanced chip sales to Megaspeed, the firm at the center of the Nvidia-China scandal. The internal rift reveals significant policy disagreement within the Trump administration over export controls on AI hardware to China.

articles.title: AI has proved that a theory underpinning fundamental physics is trustworthy
articles.summary: AI has validated a foundational theory in fundamental physics, though key insights are attributed to human physicists who guided the process. This demonstrates AI's growing utility as a research tool in hard sciences, potentially accelerating breakthroughs in theoretical physics.

articles.title: Rubenstein on the Anthropic IPO, Nvidia CEO Scandal
articles.summary: Carlyle Group co-Chairman David Rubenstein projected Anthropic's IPO valuation could reach $1.3 trillion and expressed confidence that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will retain his position despite the ongoing scandal. The commentary underscores strong investor confidence in frontier AI companies even amid corporate governance controversies.

articles.title: Nvidia China Scandal Demands Answers, Says Congressman
articles.summary: Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi called for congressional testimony from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over his reported relationship with a woman suspected of ties to Chinese intelligence, raising the possibility of a subpoena. The congressman also called for a review of Nvidia's China export licenses, signaling potential legislative action that could tighten AI chip export policy.

articles.title: Google Adds Gemini Voice AI Assistant to Apple CarPlay
articles.summary: Google is integrating its Gemini AI voice assistant into Apple's CarPlay system, giving drivers broader access to the assistant directly from their vehicles. This expansion marks a significant step in embedding large language model-based assistants into everyday mobility infrastructure.

articles.title: United Blocks AI Agents From Booking Flights Ahead of Holidays
articles.summary: United Airlines is blocking third-party AI agents from booking flights or accessing customer accounts ahead of the holiday travel season, citing privacy concerns. The move highlights growing corporate resistance to autonomous AI agents operating in sensitive commercial environments, with potential implications for the agentic AI industry.

articles.title: Odd Lots: The AI Trade Shrugs Off a Blue Wave and a Tech Scandal
articles.summary: Despite a Democratic electoral sweep raising questions about AI policy and the Nvidia CEO scandal rattling sentiment, markets are rallying ahead of the anticipated Anthropic IPO. The resilience of AI-related equities suggests investor confidence in long-term AI growth outweighs near-term political and governance risks.

articles.title: AI Optimism Reignites the Tech Trade
articles.summary: CoreWeave's upbeat earnings forecast and Anthropic's blockbuster IPO are reigniting bullish sentiment across the AI and tech trade, even as the Nvidia scandal creates political uncertainty. The combined signals suggest the market views AI infrastructure and model development as structurally strong despite governance headwinds.

articles.title: Hawley backs nationwide data center moratorium
articles.summary: Senator Josh Hawley is joining progressive Democrats in backing a nationwide moratorium on new data center construction until Congress ensures taxpayers are protected from higher utility bills. The bipartisan push signals that AI infrastructure buildout is becoming a flashpoint for energy cost and regulatory debates at the federal level.

articles.title: SpaceX develops its own ‘Kessel’ rack-scale system featuring 72 Nvidia Rubin GPUs for data centers in space, report claims
articles.summary: SpaceX is reportedly developing a 'Kessel' rack-scale computing system featuring 72 Nvidia Rubin GPUs built on an 84-layer PCB midplane, intended for space-based data centers. The development points to an emerging frontier for AI compute infrastructure in orbit, with significant implications for both the AI hardware and space industries.

articles.title: Softbank loses $3.7 billion on canceled AI data center gas turbine orders days after denying Elon Musk’s claim it was defaulting
articles.summary: SoftBank has pulled out of gas turbine orders worth $3.7 billion after overestimating how many power units it would need for its AI data center expansion. The cancellation reveals the volatility and miscalculation risks in AI infrastructure planning, with major financial consequences for companies scaling aggressively.

articles.title: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
articles.summary: Many announced AI data center projects face serious obstacles including local community opposition, permitting delays, and electricity shortages, with a large share potentially never being built. This infrastructure bottleneck could constrain the pace of AI scaling and shift competitive advantages toward players who already have operational capacity.

articles.title: China’s Nvidia Honeypot Isn’t Surprising. Jensen Huang Fell for It Anyway
articles.summary: Analysis examines how Jensen Huang, despite being the world's most powerful AI executive, fell victim to China's well-documented sexpionage intelligence tactics. The piece raises concerns about the vulnerability of top tech leaders to foreign intelligence operations targeting the AI industry.

articles.title: Big Walk used AI to fix a bug. Now the indie gaming world is having a reckoning.
articles.summary: Indie game studio Big Walk's use of AI to fix a bug sparked a broader reckoning in the independent gaming community, with many Independent Games Festival judges declaring any AI-generated code disqualifying. The controversy reflects deepening tensions over AI's role in creative industries and how communities are setting their own ethical standards ahead of formal regulation.

articles.title: Token Pooling-Aware Training for Multi-Vector Embedding Models
articles.summary: A research paper introduces token pooling-aware training techniques for multi-vector embedding models, aiming to improve efficiency and performance in dense retrieval systems. Advances in embedding model training are foundational to improving search, RAG pipelines, and AI knowledge retrieval.

articles.title: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters
articles.summary: Adobe revealed experimental AI features at its Max conference, including tools that convert photos into explorable 3D scenes, enable designers to create AI characters through conversation, and simplify photo editing via copy-paste workflows. These tools signal Adobe's aggressive expansion of generative AI into creative professional workflows.

articles.title: Is Jensen Huang’s bad behavior more commonplace than it seems?
articles.summary: An investment intelligence consultant alleged that Jensen Huang's behavior with the alleged Chinese spy is more widely known in the tech industry than publicly acknowledged, with senior figures effectively condoning it. The claim raises broader questions about security culture and accountability at the top of the AI industry.

articles.title: Databricks’ new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
articles.summary: Databricks CEO Ali Ghodsi uses a revised version of the company's Genie AI agent to get unfiltered internal feedback about company operations that employees are unlikely to share directly. The use case highlights a growing trend of executives deploying AI agents for organizational intelligence and transparency at scale.

articles.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
articles.summary: Startup Plurai is applying end-to-end training approaches borrowed from autonomous vehicle development to make AI agents more reliable in unpredictable real-world environments. The methodology could address one of the core reliability challenges limiting enterprise adoption of agentic AI systems.

articles.title: IBM to offer access to a dual-processor quantum system in 2027
articles.summary: IBM announced plans to offer access to a dual-processor quantum system linking two 520-qubit chips by 2027, marking a step toward more powerful quantum computing architectures. The development is relevant to AI as quantum computing could eventually accelerate certain machine learning workloads and optimization problems.

articles.title: Silicon Valley Tech Allies Support Jensen Huang
articles.summary: Elon Musk and other Silicon Valley figures publicly defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, framing his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy as a personal failing rather than a national security issue. The tech community's closing of ranks around Huang highlights tensions between industry loyalty and security accountability at the AI-geopolitics nexus.

articles.title: This Trader Raised Alarm About Nvidia’s China Entanglements Months Ago
articles.summary: Short seller Christian Lamarco, 31, publicly warned about financial and personal problems at Nvidia as early as May, months before the scandal became mainstream news. His early alarm highlights how intelligence about corporate governance risks at major AI chipmakers can surface in financial markets before regulatory or media scrutiny catches up.

articles.title: JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
articles.summary: JioStar's chief architect Vijay Seshadri shared lessons on deploying AI recommendation and discovery systems at a 500-million-user scale, covering evaluation frameworks and production guardrails. The case study offers rare insight into operationalizing AI at massive consumer scale in a developing market.

articles.title: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
articles.summary: Google launched an experimental AI tool called Tabletop that lets users vibe-code custom collaborative apps for coordinating with family and friends by describing what they want. The tool reflects Google's broader push to democratize app creation through natural-language AI interfaces.

articles.title: I Saw the Future of Robotics in a Virtual Duck That Chases My Cat
articles.summary: A writer used an OpenAI model to program a Microduck robot to perform tasks like waddling and interacting with a cat, illustrating how AI is lowering the barrier to consumer robotics programming. The anecdote reflects the growing accessibility of AI-powered robotics beyond industrial or research settings.

articles.title: 百度发布文心5.5Flash Preview:2800亿参数、百万Token上下文，权重11月25日开源
articles.summary: Baidu released Wenxin 5.5 Flash Preview, a 280-billion-parameter model with 1-million-token context support, with open-source weights planned for November 25. The model demonstrates strong performance in coding, 3D modeling, and long-horizon development tasks, reinforcing Baidu's position in China's competitive foundation model race.

articles.title: 阿里千问全新一代 Qwen4 大模型官宣：多维能力大幅进化，预览版已正式上线
articles.summary: Alibaba announced the forthcoming full release of Qwen4, its next-generation large language model, with a preview version of Qwen4-Max already available at a limited-time discount of up to 90% off. Qwen4 features major advances in knowledge understanding, world perception, coding, and agentic capabilities, deepening Alibaba's competition in the foundation model market.

articles.title: Nvidia loses ground in Washington chip fight after CEO spy scandal
articles.summary: Revelations from a spy scandal involving Jensen Huang have weakened Nvidia's position in Washington as it fights proposed curbs on AI chip exports. The controversy could accelerate restrictions that would significantly limit Nvidia's ability to sell advanced chips in key overseas markets.

articles.title: Kimi开始"出租"数字员工：Agent计价锚点，正从软件预算滑向人力预算
articles.summary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) launched a managed AI agent service, which the article argues represents a fundamental shift from selling tokens to renting 'digital employees,' with pricing anchors moving from IT budgets toward labor budgets. This reframing could reshape how enterprises budget for AI, blurring the line between software costs and workforce costs.

articles.title: 中国55%的Token烧在短剧，美国58%烧在代码：Token的流向，暴露了AI的两种“活法”
articles.summary: An analysis comparing AI token consumption patterns finds that in China approximately 55% of tokens are spent on short-drama content generation, while in the U.S. about 58% go toward coding tasks, revealing two fundamentally different models of AI adoption—entertainment-driven versus productivity-driven. This divergence in usage patterns has significant implications for the long-term commercial and societal value generated by AI in each market.

articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist - Reuters
articles.summary: A Chinese university reportedly acquired Nvidia H200 chips in defiance of US export blacklist restrictions, according to an exclusive Reuters report. The incident underscores the difficulty of enforcing chip export controls and the ongoing efforts by Chinese entities to circumvent US restrictions on advanced AI hardware.

articles.title: OpenAI posts steep losses even as quarterly revenue rises to $10 billion, WSJ reports - Reuters
articles.summary: OpenAI's quarterly revenue has reached $10 billion, but the company continues to post steep losses as reported by the Wall Street Journal. This financial picture highlights the enormous capital intensity of frontier AI development and raises questions about OpenAI's path to profitability ahead of its anticipated restructuring.

articles.title: ByteDance Prepares Muse-Like Agent in Push to Close AI Gap
articles.summary: ByteDance is preparing to release a Muse-like AI agent in the coming weeks, aiming to close the capability gap with leading US AI labs within three years. The move reflects China's intensifying effort to compete at the frontier of AI development, particularly in AI-generated video and agentic systems.

articles.title: How Singapore became a route for Nvidia chips to China
articles.summary: An investigation reveals how Singapore has become a transit hub enabling Nvidia chips to reach China despite US export controls, involving a suspected Chinese spy and local chip deals exploiting regional networks. The report exposes vulnerabilities in Washington's technology containment strategy and the complex Asian supply chain networks facilitating circumvention.

articles.title: Senate Banking Republican calls on Nvidia CEO to resign
articles.summary: Senator Kevin Cramer called for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to resign, citing national security concerns stemming from a spy scandal. The call from a senior Republican senator signals that the political fallout for Nvidia is bipartisan and escalating.

articles.title: 纯代码造《后室》，116秒切20种画风！文心新模型玩嗨了
articles.summary: Baidu's new Wenxin model reportedly generated a 116-second video switching through 20 visual styles using pure code, showcasing advanced creative AI capabilities. This highlights Baidu's push to compete in multimodal generative AI with rapid style-switching and code-driven content creation.

articles.title: 北京互联网法院:平台误判AI生成内容未标识构成违约
articles.summary: A Beijing internet court ruled that a platform violated its contract by incorrectly flagging a user's original text as AI-generated and penalizing them, ordering the content restored and violation records deleted. The case highlights the legal risks of using automated AI-detection tools to enforce content labeling policies without sufficient accuracy.

articles.title: 腾讯元宝搜索上线独立网页版，B端能力向C端延伸
articles.summary: Tencent launched a standalone web version of its Yuanbao AI search product at so.qq.com, offering AI-generated answers alongside traditional search results with access to WeChat ecosystem content including public accounts and video channels. The move signals Tencent's bid to compete directly in the AI-powered consumer search market.

articles.title: AI 大模型也赶双 11：智谱、MiniMax 与阿里云等集体开启低折扣促销
articles.summary: During China's Double 11 shopping festival, major AI model providers including Zhipu, MiniMax, Qianwen, and Alibaba Cloud offered unprecedented discounts on token packages and AI products via Tmall's AI space station. The collective promotional push reflects intensifying competition among Chinese AI vendors to grow their user bases through aggressive pricing.

articles.title: 灵光托管事务量突破300万，个人AI助理开始比拼“管事能力”
articles.summary: Ant Group's personal AI assistant Lingguang 2.0 surpassed 3 million managed tasks and over 11 million task executions within two weeks of its October 27 launch, with a user base exceeding 20 million. The milestone signals a shift in how AI assistants are evaluated—from conversation counts toward the volume and complexity of tasks autonomously managed on users' behalf.

articles.title: 国产文生图模型首度登顶全球第一！ArtArk 斩获 SuperCLUE 榜首：图文一致性唯一斩获满分
articles.summary: Chinese text-to-image model ArtArk topped the SuperCLUE global image generation benchmark with a score of 95.14, surpassing GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and achieving the only perfect score in image-text consistency. This marks the first time a Chinese-developed model has claimed the top spot in a global image generation ranking, underscoring rapid advances in China's generative AI capabilities.

articles.title: Shengshu’s First AI Feature Film Misses the Mark as Its Hong Kong IPO Nears
articles.summary: China's first AI-assisted theatrical film from Shengshu Technology underperformed at the box office as the company approaches a Hong Kong IPO, raising investor concerns about its ability to monetize AI video generation technology. The case highlights the gap between technical capabilities in controllable AI video and commercial viability in the entertainment market.

articles.title: 中国AI，越来越烧钱
articles.summary: Chinese AI companies are facing rapidly escalating capital requirements as competition intensifies, creating mounting tension between heavy investment and the need to demonstrate profitability. This financial pressure could accelerate consolidation and reshape China's AI industry structure.

articles.title: 姚期智杨植麟联手，让数学家松了一口气
articles.summary: Turing Award winner Andrew Yao and Moonshot AI founder Yang Zhilin have collaborated on an AI mathematics research project, though current models remain unable to solve open mathematical conjectures. The work reflects growing interest in applying frontier AI to formal mathematical reasoning while acknowledging its current limitations.

articles.title: Anthropic继续收紧禁止中国使用的政策
articles.summary: Anthropic has further tightened its policies restricting access to its AI services from China, continuing a trend of U.S. AI companies limiting Chinese users amid geopolitical tensions. This move aligns with broader U.S. efforts to prevent American AI technology from being accessed or exploited by Chinese entities.

articles.title: Why Is It So Hard to Teach A.I. Agents to Behave? Researchers Have a Theory.
articles.summary: Researchers are exploring why training AI agents to reliably follow human direction without deception or resistance remains fundamentally difficult, proposing new theoretical frameworks for the problem. This work is central to AI alignment and the safe deployment of autonomous AI systems.

articles.title: US and China should stay clear-eyed on AI cooperation and competition, Bessent says - Reuters
articles.summary: US Treasury Secretary Bessent called for the US and China to maintain clear-eyed perspectives on both AI cooperation and competition, signaling a nuanced diplomatic stance on the technology rivalry. The statement reflects growing recognition that AI governance requires balancing competitive pressures with potential areas for bilateral engagement.

articles.title: Germany's Helsing to unveil AI-based military software as a rival to Palantir - Reuters
articles.summary: German defense AI company Helsing is set to unveil its Clarity platform, an AI-based military software system designed to rival Palantir's offerings in the defense sector. The launch reflects Europe's push to develop homegrown defense AI capabilities amid growing geopolitical tensions and reliance on US technology.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s AI Chatbot Grok Sexualized These Teens’ Childhood Photos
articles.summary: Elon Musk's xAI chatbot Grok has been found to generate sexualized content from childhood photos of real teenagers, with victims saying the images are nearly impossible to remove. The case is fueling demands for accountability and tighter safety measures around generative AI image capabilities.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Mythos AI Looking for Cyber Flaws in Energy Systems
articles.summary: Anthropic's Mythos AI tool is being used by power companies to detect cybersecurity vulnerabilities in critical energy infrastructure, following months of lobbying for access to advanced AI models. The deployment marks a significant step in applying frontier AI to protect critical national infrastructure from cyberattacks.

articles.title: Kai-Fu Lee Questions Soaring AI Valuations
articles.summary: AI pioneer and investor Kai-Fu Lee has publicly questioned whether soaring trillion-dollar AI valuations are justified, citing risks from circular funding structures and the pressure from cheaper Chinese and open-source models. His comments add prominent skeptical voices to debates about AI market sustainability and the competitive threat from non-US AI development.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Demand Surges as AI Trade Roars Back
articles.summary: Demand for Anthropic's upcoming IPO has surged strongly, coinciding with renewed investor enthusiasm for AI stocks following CoreWeave's strong results. The robust IPO appetite signals sustained market confidence in frontier AI companies despite high valuations and ongoing losses.

articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO is too important to fail
articles.summary: Analysis of Anthropic's upcoming IPO highlights massive investor demand but flags concerns including insider secondary sales and circular supply-chain relationships with backers like Amazon that could create post-listing volatility. The piece raises structural questions about whether the IPO's fundamentals can sustain its blockbuster debut valuation.

articles.title: CoreWeave Reports Revenue Surge But Huge Increase in Cash Burn - The Information
articles.summary: CoreWeave reported a significant surge in revenue alongside a dramatic increase in cash burn in its latest financial results. The figures highlight the capital-intensive nature of AI cloud infrastructure and raise questions about long-term profitability in the sector.

articles.title: Congress could issue subpoena to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang if he doesn’t respond by today to request for a ‘joint, closed-door briefing’
articles.summary: Three congressional committee chairs threatened to subpoena Jensen Huang if he did not agree to a closed-door briefing about Nvidia's security protocols against foreign espionage. The escalation reflects growing legislative concern over whether the CEO's high profile and company's global reach create national security vulnerabilities.

articles.title: 红果短剧给 AI 角色"上户口"：虚拟形象也能确权了
articles.summary: Chinese short-drama platform Hongguo launched a virtual identity registration and rights-verification system for AI-generated characters, requiring creators to submit proof of authorization (real-person consent, IP license, or original design) before using AI avatars. This is an early industry attempt to establish clear ownership frameworks for AI-generated likenesses amid rising legal ambiguity.

articles.title: 黄仁勋危局：CEO职位恐不保，一段婚外情背后的出口管制风暴
articles.summary: Cybersecurity expert Dmitri Alperovitch stated on CNBC that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces serious risk of losing his position, not over a personal affair, but due to allegations of circumventing U.S. export controls and interfering with federal investigations. If substantiated, this could have major consequences for Nvidia's leadership and its compliance posture amid intensifying U.S.-China chip restrictions.

articles.title: AI短剧混战：大厂争夺的是剧本，还是下一代流量入口
articles.summary: Major Chinese tech platforms are competing in the AI short-drama market, with control over content approval, traffic distribution, and revenue-sharing terms identified as the decisive competitive levers. The battle frames AI-generated short dramas not just as a content format but as a potential next-generation traffic platform for big tech.

articles.title: 大模型的注意力探针安全检测机制
articles.summary: A research or technical article discusses using attention probe mechanisms in large language models as a safety detection method to identify potentially harmful or misaligned behaviors. Attention-based probing represents an emerging approach in AI safety research to interpret model internals and flag safety risks.

articles.title: A 13-Year-Old Asked AI About Suicide on Her School Laptop. It Didn’t Get Flagged for Weeks
articles.summary: A 13-year-old reportedly used Google's Gemini AI on her school Chromebook to research suicide methods, with the school's monitoring systems failing to flag the activity for weeks. The incident highlights critical gaps in AI safety guardrails for minors and raises urgent questions about deployment of AI tools in educational settings.

articles.title: Banks seek to rein in soaring AI agent costs, McKinsey says - Reuters
articles.summary: McKinsey reports that banks are actively seeking to control rapidly escalating costs associated with deploying AI agents across their operations. The trend signals that enterprise AI adoption is entering a phase of economic scrutiny, where ROI and cost efficiency are becoming as important as capability.

articles.title: Nvidia-backed AI cloud firm Nscale considers delaying $35 billion listing, the Telegraph reports - Reuters
articles.summary: Nscale, an AI cloud firm backed by Nvidia, is reportedly considering delaying its planned $35 billion stock market listing. The potential delay may reflect market uncertainty around AI infrastructure valuations despite strong investor interest in the sector.

articles.title: Israeli AI security startup Bay raises $50 million - Reuters
articles.summary: Israeli AI security startup Bay has raised $50 million in funding to advance its cybersecurity offerings. The investment reflects continued strong investor appetite for AI-driven security solutions amid escalating cyber threats.

articles.title: Utah-Based Startup Raises $500 Million for Modular AI Data Center
articles.summary: Utah-based energy storage startup Torus raised $500 million to develop a modular, shipping container-sized product that integrates battery storage with AI computing infrastructure. The funding highlights the growing convergence of energy and AI hardware as data center power demands surge.

articles.title: Airbnb Is Building Its Own AI Travel Agent, Co-Founder Says
articles.summary: Airbnb co-founder Nathan Blecharczyk revealed the company is building its own specialized AI travel agent capable of booking both on and off the Airbnb platform. This move positions Airbnb to compete in the emerging AI-powered travel booking space while extending its reach beyond its own marketplace.

articles.title: How much is Anthropic really worth? Use our calculator
articles.summary: The Financial Times has published an interactive valuation calculator for Anthropic as the company prepares its Wall Street IPO debut, illustrating the wide range of plausible valuations from $500 billion to $4 trillion. The tool underscores deep uncertainty about how to price frontier AI companies given their rapid growth but significant losses.

articles.title: Booz Allen Switches to Nvidia’s Nemotron - The Information
articles.summary: Booz Allen Hamilton has switched to Nvidia's Nemotron model for its AI operations, signaling a major enterprise adoption milestone for the model. The move by a leading defense and government contractor underscores Nvidia's growing footprint beyond hardware into AI foundation models.

articles.title: Rapidus reportedly falls behind schedule on 2nm chip production target, raising questions over Japan's chip ambitions
articles.summary: Japan's Rapidus has reportedly fallen behind schedule on its 2nm chip production target, casting doubt on the country's ambitions to become a leading semiconductor manufacturer. The delay raises broader questions about whether national industrial policy efforts can realistically challenge established chipmaking leaders like TSMC.

articles.title: Elon Musk wants to build a s $24 billion gas-powered AI supercomputer in Texas company town
articles.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX company town of Starbase, Texas, is set to vote on a proposed $24 billion gas-powered AI supercomputer data center project within its limits. Despite Musk's control over Starbase, local regulatory dynamics may complicate approval, highlighting the infrastructure and governance challenges of building large-scale AI compute facilities.

articles.title: AMD 亮出本地编程平台 Instinct Coder 355：一台机器塞进 98% 前沿模型
articles.summary: AMD and Spectro Cloud launched the Instinct Coder 355, an enterprise on-premises AI coding platform powered by eight MI355X GPUs capable of running frontier-level models at 98% performance parity with cloud alternatives. The platform targets enterprises seeking to keep AI workloads local, intensifying AMD's competition with Nvidia in the AI hardware and inference market.

articles.title: 上海国资，加码AI设计芯片 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: Shanghai state-owned capital is increasing investment in AI chip design companies, reflecting China's strategic push to develop domestic semiconductor capabilities amid ongoing export restrictions. This move underscores the role of government-backed funding in accelerating China's AI hardware independence.

articles.title: 美司法部成立“超级智能特别工作组”，打击智能技术滥用活动
articles.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice has established a dedicated 'Superintelligence Task Force' aimed at combating criminal misuse of advanced AI technologies. This signals a significant escalation in federal law enforcement's focus on AI-related threats and regulatory oversight.

articles.title: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
articles.summary: BotPsy is a proposed on-device personal assistant powered by a sub-billion-parameter agentic language model. This research is relevant to the trend of deploying capable AI agents on edge devices without cloud dependency, addressing privacy and latency concerns.

articles.title: AMD unveils three-gen EPYC roadmap as TSMC 2nm process advances
articles.summary: AMD unveiled a three-generation roadmap for its EPYC server processors, timed alongside advances in TSMC's 2nm manufacturing process. The announcement signals AMD's intent to maintain competitive pressure on Intel and Nvidia in the data center chip market.

articles.title: 双11直播间爆改AI秀场，罗永浩上手TRAE，秒变AI Coding的大众嘴替
articles.summary: During China's Double 11 shopping festival, entrepreneur Luo Yonghao demonstrated Bytedance's TRAE AI coding tool in a live-stream, positioning it as an accessible AI coding platform for mainstream users. The event signals growing efforts by Chinese tech companies to popularize AI coding tools beyond developer communities.

articles.title: Cogent and OpenAI build cyber defense factories for enterprises
articles.summary: Cogent has partnered with OpenAI to build AI-powered cyber defense tools that automatically remediate enterprise vulnerabilities using agentic models with enterprise context. This signals an emerging category of AI-native cybersecurity solutions leveraging large language models to automate threat response.

articles.title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
articles.summary: Corporate governance experts are scrutinizing an unprecedented situation unfolding at Nvidia, with observers describing it as unlike anything previously seen. The controversy raises questions about oversight and accountability at one of AI's most critical hardware suppliers.

articles.title: Singapore Airlines elevates travel & work with OpenAI technology
articles.summary: Singapore Airlines has integrated OpenAI models and APIs into its operations, doubling customer satisfaction scores for its Kris chatbot while also enhancing employee productivity and travel discovery tools. This deployment demonstrates growing enterprise adoption of frontier AI models for customer-facing and internal workflows in the aviation sector.

articles.title: The Download: preserving minds and weighing open AI risks
articles.summary: MIT Technology Review's daily newsletter covers two topics: speculative ideas for digital mind preservation and an assessment of risks associated with open-source AI models. These discussions reflect broader debates in AI safety, identity, and the tradeoffs of open versus closed AI development.

articles.title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
articles.summary: OpenAI reports that more than 20,000 U.S. veterans and transitioning service members have claimed free one-year ChatGPT Plus subscriptions, primarily using the tool to prepare for civilian careers. The program demonstrates a growing use of AI assistants for workforce transition and vocational upskilling in a high-impact social context.

articles.title: OpenAI Third-Quarter Revenue Soars Nearly 50% to $10 Billion
articles.summary: OpenAI's quarterly revenue reached $10 billion for the first time in Q3, driven by strong demand for its latest AI software products, representing nearly 50% growth. The milestone cements OpenAI's position as the most commercially successful frontier AI lab and intensifies pressure on competitors.

articles.title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic has set its IPO price range at $70–$78 per share, targeting a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, which would make it one of the largest IPOs ever. The valuation reflects enormous investor confidence in frontier AI but also comes in below some earlier expectations, signaling measured market sentiment.

articles.title: DeepMind reveals Gemini Robotics 2.5 and open safety benchmark "ASIMOV-jailbreak"
articles.summary: Google DeepMind revealed Gemini Robotics 2.5, achieving up to twice the success rate on certain tasks compared to its predecessor, alongside an open safety benchmark called 'ASIMOV-jailbreak' for evaluating robotic AI safety. The dual release advances both robotic AI capability and the nascent field of robot safety evaluation.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Giant IPO Will Tie It Closer to Nvidia
articles.summary: Nvidia plans to invest $10 billion in Anthropic as part of Anthropic's upcoming IPO, the largest single financial commitment from a major tech firm in the deal. The investment would tightly link the dominant AI chip maker with a leading foundation model company, reshaping competitive dynamics in the AI ecosystem.

articles.title: Trump says FBI probing Nvidia CEO Huang as China controversy deepens - Reuters
articles.summary: President Trump stated the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in connection with his relationship with a woman identified as a Chinese intelligence asset. The federal probe elevates the scandal from a corporate governance issue to a national security matter with potential legal consequences.

articles.title: MiniMax开源H3-Image:10秒生成16MP图像，价格仅同档工具50%–70%
articles.summary: MiniMax released its open-weight H3-Image model on November 10, capable of generating 16MP 4K images in under 10 seconds—five times faster than mainstream alternatives—at 50–70% of competitor pricing. The model's combination of speed, quality, and open access significantly lowers the barrier for high-resolution image generation and challenges proprietary incumbents.

articles.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 accelerates real-world general dexterity
articles.summary: Google has released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model, designed to improve robot dexterity, reliability, and safety in real-world tasks. The advancement accelerates the integration of frontier AI reasoning into physical robotics systems, a key battleground for general-purpose AI.

articles.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
articles.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Carbon to the general public, touting it as its strongest model yet with an agent 'swarm' feature and cybersecurity capabilities competitive with Anthropic and OpenAI. The release marks a significant escalation in the frontier model race and introduces multi-agent coordination as a key differentiator.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
articles.summary: New York's AI safety law has taken effect, requiring major AI developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face financial penalties. The regulation represents one of the most concrete state-level AI oversight frameworks in the US, setting a precedent that could influence national policy.

articles.title: Amazon and Google Will See Big Paydays from Anthropic IPO
articles.summary: Amazon and Google, as Anthropic's largest investors, stand to gain hundreds of billions of dollars in value if Anthropic's anticipated IPO proceeds. The payoff would validate the hyperscalers' strategy of making large early bets on frontier AI labs to secure both financial returns and strategic cloud partnerships.

articles.title: Alibaba AI chip unit T-Head files for Hong Kong IPO - Reuters
articles.summary: Alibaba's AI chip unit T-Head has filed for an IPO on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, seeking to raise capital to compete in the global AI semiconductor market. The listing signals China's push to develop independent AI chip capabilities amid ongoing U.S. export restrictions.

articles.title: OpenAI Revenue Jumps to $10 Billion in Third Quarter Amid Growing Losses - The Information
articles.summary: OpenAI's revenue surged to $10 billion in the third quarter, though losses also continued to grow at a significant pace. The figures underscore OpenAI's rapid commercial traction while highlighting the enormous costs of competing at the frontier of AI development.

articles.title: Anthropic Discloses Over $10 Billion in New Deals with Microsoft, Google; Says Lambda Deal May Be Cancelled - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic has disclosed over $10 billion in new cloud computing deals with Microsoft and Google, while revealing that a previously announced deal with Lambda may be cancelled. These partnerships cement Anthropic's deep ties with the two dominant cloud providers and reduce its dependence on independent GPU cloud operators.

articles.title: Anthropic Sets Lower than Expected Valuation, Seeks to Raise $90 Billion in IPO - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic is seeking to raise funds at a valuation of approximately $90 billion in its IPO, with early reports suggesting this is lower than some investor expectations. The offering will be a key test of public market appetite for high-growth, pre-profitability AI companies.

articles.title: TSMC plans investments in Anthropic, OpenAI; sets up investment firm to expand semiconductor strategy
articles.summary: TSMC is planning investments in both Anthropic and OpenAI and is establishing a dedicated investment firm to expand its strategic role in the AI ecosystem beyond chip manufacturing. This move positions the world's leading chipmaker as an active stakeholder in frontier AI, deepening the hardware-software integration across the AI supply chain.

articles.title: Alice Huang reportedly instrumental in securing over $7.5 billion of Nvidia AI GPU imports during three-year relationship with Jensen Huang
articles.summary: Alice Huang, the executive alleged to be a Chinese spy in a relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, reportedly played a key role in facilitating over $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia GPU imports for Chinese companies over three years. The report raises serious national security concerns about whether U.S. export controls on advanced AI chips were effectively circumvented through personal relationships at the executive level.

articles.title: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched an AI-powered office productivity suite, expanding beyond its enterprise and coding tools to compete more directly with OpenAI and other frontier labs in workplace applications. The move signals Anthropic's ambition to broaden its commercial footprint as it approaches its IPO.

articles.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
articles.summary: All seven Anthropic co-founders plan to sell identical share allocations in the company's IPO, each netting approximately $250 million while collectively retaining control of the company. The structured insider sale reflects both the founders' confidence in the company's long-term trajectory and their desire to maintain governance control post-IPO.

articles.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
articles.summary: Startup PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a longstanding fundamental question in quantum computing, aiming to commercialize AI-driven scientific discovery. This signals a growing market for AI applied to hard scientific problems, potentially accelerating research timelines across disciplines.

articles.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
articles.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, an AI assistant that joins live workplace calls to draft plans, create timelines, answer questions, and retrieve information from connected work apps in real time. The product deepens Claude's integration into enterprise workflows, intensifying competition with Microsoft Copilot and Google's workplace AI tools.

articles.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
articles.summary: Google unveiled two new specialized tensor processing units (TPUs) designed for confidential model training and higher memory capacity, broadening its AI hardware portfolio. This expands Google's ability to serve diverse enterprise AI workloads and reduces reliance on third-party chip suppliers.

articles.title: AI training startup Mercor valued at $20 billion in latest funding round - Reuters
articles.summary: AI training data startup Mercor has been valued at $20 billion in its latest funding round, reflecting surging investor demand for infrastructure supporting AI model training. The valuation underscores how ancillary AI services, particularly data and human feedback pipelines, are attracting massive capital.

articles.title: CoreWeave Quiets Doubts About AI Business With Upbeat Outlook
articles.summary: AI cloud computing provider CoreWeave delivered a strong quarterly report with upbeat forward guidance, easing investor fears about its heavily debt-financed business model and slowing AI infrastructure demand. The results suggest that enterprise demand for AI compute remains robust despite broader data center industry headwinds.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Members Tap Wachtell’s Kim for Huang Probe
articles.summary: Nvidia's independent board members have hired a former top federal prosecutor from law firm Wachtell to lead an internal investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's ties to a suspected Chinese intelligence operative. The formal legal probe signals that the board is treating the matter as a serious corporate governance and national security issue.

articles.title: Anthropic Investors Shop IPO Shares Early, and at a Big Premium
articles.summary: Some early Anthropic investors are offering portions of their IPO share allocations to new investors at a significant premium ahead of what could be a record-breaking public listing. This signals exceptionally high demand for Anthropic equity and reflects broader investor enthusiasm for frontier AI companies.

articles.title: CoreWeave plans multibillion-dollar chip-backed debt deal
articles.summary: CoreWeave is pursuing a multibillion-dollar asset-backed debt deal, using its chip infrastructure as collateral and leveraging customer pre-payments to secure financing. This reflects the growing complexity of funding AI infrastructure buildouts as traditional capital markets struggle to keep pace with demand.

articles.title: Nvidia hires former US prosecutor at Wachtell to lead Jensen Huang probe
articles.summary: Nvidia has retained prominent law firm Wachtell Lipton, hiring a former federal prosecutor, to lead an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's alleged romantic relationship with an individual accused of being a Chinese spy. The probe reflects heightened scrutiny of potential national security vulnerabilities at the top of one of the world's most critical AI chip companies.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs expects Anthropic revenue to exceed $600bn by 2030
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs projects Anthropic's revenue will exceed $600 billion by 2030, representing a roughly 130-fold increase from current levels, with the company becoming cash-flow positive by decade's end. The forecast reflects Wall Street's increasingly bullish stance on frontier AI monetization, adding pressure on competitors to scale rapidly.

articles.title: Trahan crafting AI safety bill with narrower state preemption
articles.summary: Congresswoman Trahan is drafting an AI safety bill that would preempt state AI regulations only in a narrower set of circumstances, a shift from broader federal preemption proposals. This approach reflects ongoing political tensions between federal AI oversight and states' rights to regulate AI, particularly in a potentially Democrat-controlled Congress.

articles.title: Google Grapples With AI’s Hit to Its Ads Juggernaut - The Information
articles.summary: Google is grappling with the impact of AI-powered search and competitors on its core advertising business, as AI-generated answers reduce user clicks on traditional search ads. This represents a structural threat to Google's primary revenue engine and signals a broader industry shift in how AI is reshaping digital advertising economics.

articles.title: Microsoft lobbies against potential ban on Chinese optical networking gear for AI data centers as FCC mulls restricting imports
articles.summary: Microsoft is lobbying against a potential FCC ban on Chinese-made optical networking components used in AI data centers, arguing the restrictions could disrupt critical infrastructure buildouts. The case illustrates the tension between national security-driven supply chain decoupling and the practical hardware dependencies of U.S. AI infrastructure.

articles.title: 2026，AI应用的钱都流向了哪里？
articles.summary: This article examines where AI application investment is flowing in 2026. It highlights shifting capital allocation trends that signal which sectors and use cases are winning commercial traction in the maturing AI market.

articles.title: 【钛晨报】李强签署国务院令，公布修订后的《基金会管理条例》；阿里拟分拆平头哥独立赴港上市；Anthropic IPO定价区间确定，目标市值约1万亿美元低于预期
articles.summary: A news roundup covers Anthropic's IPO pricing targeting a ~$1 trillion valuation, Alibaba's plan to spin off its chip unit Pingtouge for a Hong Kong IPO, and TSMC approving a $409 billion capital budget for capacity expansion. These developments collectively reflect intensifying competition and capital mobilization across the AI and semiconductor industries.

articles.title: T早报｜阿里拟分拆平头哥在港股独立上市；Anthropic启动IPO路演；特朗普称FBI正调查黄仁勋
articles.summary: A news digest reports that Alibaba plans to spin off its chip subsidiary Pingtouge for an independent Hong Kong listing, Anthropic has begun its IPO roadshow, and Trump claims the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. These items reflect major corporate and regulatory developments at the intersection of AI, chips, and geopolitics.

articles.title: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
articles.summary: ChatGPT is launching verified 'Business Agents'—brand-representing AI agents that assist users with tasks like comparison shopping—initially available to eligible US e-commerce businesses in beta. The feature transforms ChatGPT into a commerce intermediary, raising significant questions about market power and competition with traditional search and retail platforms.

articles.title: Adobe is going all in on agentic AI
articles.summary: Adobe announced at its Max conference that it is fully embracing agentic AI, enabling third-party AI agents to access and modify creative workflows within its tools. The strategy positions Adobe as an open platform in the agentic AI ecosystem, aiming to remain relevant as AI increasingly automates creative tasks.

articles.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
articles.summary: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, a travel startup founded by Sonder co-founder Francis Davidson, though its plans for the company remain undisclosed. The acquisition suggests OpenAI is exploring AI applications in the travel vertical, potentially signaling an expansion of its agentic or consumer product ambitions.

articles.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
articles.summary: Wearable health company Oura is acquiring AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625 million, weeks after postponing its own IPO due to market uncertainty. The deal signals growing investment in AI-powered healthcare and the consolidation of health data and clinical AI capabilities under consumer wellness platforms.

articles.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
articles.summary: A researcher discovered that approximately 35,000 Grok Build apps were publicly exposed, leaking confidential information including data tied to SpaceX. The breach highlights serious security and privacy risks in AI-powered development platforms, particularly those with insufficient access controls.

articles.title: Nvidia has a Jensen Huang problem—and no obvious successor
articles.summary: Nvidia faces investor and governance concerns over CEO Jensen Huang's central role and the lack of a clear successor, compounded by a board probe into his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The situation exposes significant leadership concentration risk at the company most critical to global AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Why Nvidia and Jensen Huang Matter So Much to Markets
articles.summary: Reports of Jensen Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy erased roughly $1 trillion in Nvidia market value, illustrating how leadership and geopolitical risk can directly impact financial markets for AI infrastructure companies. The episode highlights Nvidia's outsized systemic importance to global AI development.

articles.title: Stifel CEO on Anthropic, Integrating AI and Fed Policy
articles.summary: Stifel announced a partnership with Anthropic to deploy Claude-based tools aimed at helping financial advisers organize work and communicate with clients more effectively, without replacing human judgment. The deal illustrates the growing adoption of frontier AI models in regulated financial services and Anthropic's enterprise expansion strategy.

articles.title: Jensen Huang’s 700,000% Return Magnifies Nvidia Succession Risks
articles.summary: An in-depth profile examines Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's unique management style and the existential risks the company faces if he were to depart, given his central role in its extraordinary growth. The piece highlights how deeply Nvidia's culture, strategy, and competitive edge are tied to a single individual, raising concerns about long-term institutional resilience.

articles.title: CoreWeave Earnings Top Estimates, Boosts Annual Forecast
articles.summary: CoreWeave reported earnings that beat analyst estimates and raised its annual revenue forecast, signaling strong demand for AI compute infrastructure. However, analysts note the company faces ongoing challenges in securing additional capital to fund its capital-intensive expansion.

articles.title: US commerce department delays Megaspeed’s inclusion on trade blacklist
articles.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department delayed adding Megaspeed, a company connected to an alleged Chinese spy who reportedly had a relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, to its trade entity blacklist. The delay raises questions about the government's approach to enforcing export controls on companies with potential ties to Chinese intelligence.

articles.title: US regulator postpones Wall Street push to trade AI computing futures
articles.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has postponed Wall Street's push to create futures contracts tied to AI computing power, citing concerns over potential price manipulation. The delay slows efforts to financialize AI compute as a tradeable commodity asset class.

articles.title: Alice Huang’s tangled web of connections
articles.summary: An investigative report traces the career and connections of Alice Huang, the executive alleged to be a Chinese spy who had a relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, revealing ties to individuals with histories of regulatory violations. The profile deepens concerns about the extent of potential foreign influence surrounding Nvidia's leadership.

articles.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google

articles.title: Ring, known for its doorbell cameras, launches a home security drone and an enterprise security robot

articles.title: Quanta Computer vice chairman sees no slowdown in US AI infrastructure investment after midterms

articles.title: Pay for Hugging Face Hub with your Google Cloud Account

articles.title: What happens to mathematics when AI becomes an oracle?

articles.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI

The incident highlights growing user sensitivity around AI service pricing transparency as Chinese AI products scale their consumer bases.

articles.title: OpenAI gets $11 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation, source says - Reuters
articles.summary: OpenAI has secured $11 billion in new funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation, according to a Reuters source. This massive capital raise cements OpenAI's position as the most highly valued AI company and provides resources to sustain its competitive lead in foundation model development and infrastructure.

articles.title: 中国AI 制药变局：字节控股分拆，大厂高管下场，六成资金流向头部
articles.summary: China's AI pharmaceutical sector is undergoing a major restructuring, with ByteDance spinning off assets, major tech executives entering the space directly, and roughly 60% of funding concentrating in top players. This signals intensifying competition and consolidation in China's AI drug discovery market, with large platforms displacing smaller startups.

articles.title: Two Chinese companies cleared to buy banned Nvidia AI chips have empty offices and unknown addresses
articles.summary: Two Chinese companies—New Matrix and Maginfra—approved to purchase U.S.-restricted Nvidia H200 AI chips have offices that appear abandoned or nonexistent, raising serious concerns about shell companies circumventing export controls. This exposes critical weaknesses in enforcement of U.S. chip export restrictions targeting China.

articles.title: DeepSeek’s AI Agent Platform Hits 1.54 Million Daily Users
articles.summary: DeepSeek's AI agent platform has reached 1.54 million daily active users, demonstrating rapid adoption of its open-source-based infrastructure. This growth underscores DeepSeek's emerging role as a credible challenger to OpenAI and Anthropic in the AI agent ecosystem.

articles.title: AI Agent的信息注入攻击
articles.summary: An analysis examines information injection attacks targeting AI agents, a class of security vulnerability where malicious inputs manipulate agent behavior. This highlights growing cybersecurity risks as AI agents are deployed in autonomous, high-stakes workflows.

articles.title: Elvis and Eminem rights holders are suing Suno
articles.summary: Rights holders for Elvis Presley's music and Eminem's publisher have filed lawsuits against AI music company Suno, alleging it illegally generates music and lyrics mimicking those artists. The cases escalate legal pressure on generative AI music platforms and could set important precedents for copyright liability in AI-generated content.

articles.title: Apple Explores Turning Siri AI Into ChatGPT Dots-Like Agent; iOS 28 Shake-Up
articles.summary: Apple is reportedly exploring a redesign of Siri into a true AI agent with ChatGPT-like capabilities, planned as part of an iOS 28 overhaul. The move signals Apple's recognition that it is falling behind competitors in conversational AI and agentic functionality.

articles.title: MiniMax怎样实现AGI ？闫俊杰的办法是抄“后”路
articles.summary: MiniMax CEO Yan Junjie argues that China trails the US in AI by only 5%, but that final gap is far harder to close than the preceding 95%, and plans to pursue AGI by learning from past approaches. This perspective highlights the strategic difficulty of frontier AI competition and China's self-assessment of its position relative to leading US labs.

articles.title: Anthropic Buys Power for AI Data Centres in $3.4B Deal, FT Says
articles.summary: Anthropic has agreed to a $3.4 billion deal to purchase gas-fired power generation equipment for its AI data centers, reportedly the largest such single purchase by an AI lab. This underscores the extreme energy demands of frontier AI and the pressure on labs to secure independent power infrastructure amid surging competition.

articles.title: 刘庆峰交出科大讯飞半张AI答卷
articles.summary: iFlytek's chairman Liu Qingfeng has revealed the company's broad but scattered AI strategy, likening it to a general store covering many sectors without deep focus. This raises questions about whether diversified AI deployment can sustain competitive advantage against more focused rivals in China's AI market.

articles.title: 60万颗！英伟达H200芯片在中国香港堆积如山 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China

articles.title: 寒武纪Q3：利润翻倍，市值降温
articles.summary: Cambricon reported doubled profits in Q3, though its market capitalization has cooled from earlier highs. This reflects a maturing competitive landscape for China's domestic AI chip sector, where financial performance is improving but investor enthusiasm is moderating.

articles.title: 华为、OpenAI、字节等科技巨头为何都要插手制药？
articles.summary: Major tech giants including Huawei, OpenAI, and ByteDance are expanding into pharmaceutical drug discovery, leveraging AI to accelerate research and development pipelines. This signals a major competitive frontier where AI capabilities could dramatically reshape drug discovery timelines and costs.

articles.title: 旷视的十五岁：不再等IPO，先谈扭亏
articles.summary: Chinese AI vision company Megvii, at its 15th anniversary, has pivoted away from waiting for an IPO and is instead focusing on operational services to achieve profitability. This strategic contraction reflects broader pressures on Chinese AI startups to demonstrate sustainable business models rather than growth-at-all-costs.

articles.title: 面对面｜熊友军：机器人数据采集中心，未来能否成长为独立生意？
articles.summary: An interview with Xiong Youjun explores whether robot data collection centers—facilities that generate training data for robotic AI—can evolve into standalone, independent businesses. This matters because high-quality embodied AI training data is becoming a critical bottleneck and potential commercial opportunity in the robotics sector.

articles.title: World Models Will Soon Be Inescapable. Here’s What You Need to Know
articles.summary: World models—AI systems that simulate real-world physics in 3D space—are becoming central to training robots and autonomous vehicles to navigate physical environments. Their rise represents a fundamental shift in AI beyond language and 2D perception toward systems that can reason about and act in the physical world.

articles.title: Homelabber uses second-gen Optane memory sticks to run a 2.8-trillion-parameter AI model on CPU alone
articles.summary: A hobbyist successfully ran Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 model entirely on CPU using second-generation Intel Optane persistent memory, achieving 0.85 tokens per second with 1-bit quantization. This demonstrates that extremely large models can be run outside specialized GPU clusters, with implications for accessibility and edge deployment of frontier-scale AI.

articles.title: Will Democrats Really Crush Data Centers? - The Information
articles.summary: An analysis examines whether Democratic politicians will follow through on proposals that could restrict or slow data center construction, amid growing tension between AI infrastructure expansion and environmental or community concerns. The outcome of this political debate could significantly shape where and how fast AI compute infrastructure scales in the US.

articles.title: I Used NYT Cooking’s New AI-Powered Recipe Modifier, and It’s Actually Pretty Good
articles.summary: The New York Times has launched a beta AI-powered recipe modifier in its Cooking app, allowing users to swap ingredients and adjust recipes to their needs. This represents a practical consumer application of AI that integrates seamlessly into existing media products, demonstrating growing AI utility in everyday tools.

articles.title: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo

articles.title: He Ran on Fighting Data Centers. Now, He’s Going to Congress

His election signals growing political opposition to AI infrastructure expansion, with potential implications for the energy and resource demands of large-scale AI development.

articles.title: After the midterms, things are looking rocky for Elon Musk and data centers
articles.summary: Following the midterm elections, the political landscape is shifting in ways that could create headwinds for Elon Musk's ventures and data center expansion plans. articles.title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
articles.summary: A new METR report following an 11-week investigation found that Anthropic is successfully using AI models to accelerate AI development, doubling its pace of model improvement compared to a year ago. articles.title: 清华姚期智团队新作：代数世界模型，让AI像牛顿一样思考
articles.summary: Yao Qizhi's team at Tsinghua University has introduced an algebraic world model aimed at enabling AI to reason about the physical world in a structured, law-like manner analogous to Newtonian physics. This approach could advance AI's capacity for systematic scientific reasoning and generalization beyond pattern matching.

articles.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
articles.summary: An approved Chinese firm on Nvidia's list of entities cleared to handle H200 AI chips, New Matrix, was found to have an empty office, raising serious questions about vetting by both Nvidia and the U.S. Commerce Department. articles.summary: U.S. intelligence sources allege that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence in a honeypot operation involving a Megaspeed executive named Alice Huang. articles.title: AI Safety Advocates Make Gains After $110 Million Midterm Fight

articles.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) has extended the suspension of the 50% Affiliates Rule into 2027 as part of the ongoing U.S.-China trade truce. articles.summary: Taiwan has launched an advanced memory initiative in response to a global AI-driven memory shortage constraining AI hardware development. This move positions Taiwan to play a larger role in alleviating the memory bottleneck that is limiting AI infrastructure scaling.

articles.title: AI broke the cybersecurity world. What’s next?

articles.title: UK will not slow down on AI despite backlash in US, says growth minister

articles.title: TSMC Weighs Making Advanced Memory Chips to Capture More AI Spending - The Information
articles.summary: TSMC is weighing entry into advanced memory chip manufacturing to capture a larger share of AI-driven semiconductor spending. This potential expansion would intensify competition in the high-bandwidth memory market critical to AI accelerator performance.

articles.title: Anthropic’s R&D Speed May Have Doubled Due to AI, Researchers Find - The Information
articles.summary: Researchers have found that Anthropic's use of AI tools may have doubled its internal R&D speed, according to The Information. articles.summary: Chinese robotics expert Xiong Youjun discusses how robots capable of running, jumping, and dancing can be translated into real-world practical value. articles.summary: Former OpenAI employee Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi Arabian national arrested last month on espionage charges, has pleaded not guilty after a bug was discovered in the company's office. articles.title: All the latest updates on AI data centers
articles.summary: A roundup of ongoing developments around AI data centers covers the massive infrastructure buildout by tech companies and the resulting conflicts over energy consumption, utility costs, and community impact. This infrastructure race is a critical bottleneck shaping the pace and geography of AI development globally.

articles.title: Anthropic Launches Personal Finance Feature for Claude - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched a personal finance feature for its Claude AI assistant, expanding the chatbot's capabilities into consumer financial management. This move signals Anthropic's push into specialized consumer applications to diversify revenue beyond enterprise and API customers.

articles.summary: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis suffered a 'multifront cyberattack' in which hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers, with the attack involving AI agents and an on-path data interception. articles.summary: An experiment testing AI models' hacking capabilities found that Chinese open-source models DeepSeek and GLM performed nearly as well as OpenAI's advanced, non-public cyber model in breaking into simulated networks. articles.summary: Corporate spending data from Ramp shows AI expenditure has plateaued even as usage grows, driven by price cuts and cost controls among major enterprise customers, complicating growth narratives ahead of Anthropic's IPO. articles.summary: Nvidia is requiring Southeast Asian cloud partners to enroll in its Fleet Intelligence GPU tracking program to gain greater visibility into where its AI chips are deployed, amid U.S. scrutiny over suspected smuggling of chips into China. The case sets a precedent for how workplace AI usage policies and information security rules interact with employee rights.

articles.summary: Sohu founder Charles Zhang publicly admitted the company missed the mobile internet wave and explained that Sohu is deliberately avoiding aggressive investment in large AI models due to resource constraints. His remarks highlight how legacy Chinese internet companies are strategically cautious amid the AI race.

articles.title: Fourier’s Meta Prototype Puts a Spotlight on an 8-Billion-Yuan Robotics Bet
articles.summary: Shanghai-based Fourier Intelligence built a custom humanoid robot for Meta's internal research operations, showcasing its engineering capabilities alongside its disclosed ~8 billion yuan pre-money valuation. While the Meta partnership is a marquee signal, analysts note it validates technical credibility more than it justifies the equity story.

articles.title: Claude Code华人一姐，闪电跳槽到OpenAI，大厂为何留不住人才？
articles.summary: Catherine Wu (Cat Wu), the lead product executive behind Claude Code at Anthropic, announced her departure from Anthropic and near-simultaneously joined OpenAI to lead product management for a core product team. The rapid talent movement highlights fierce inter-lab competition for top AI product leaders.

articles.title: 工信部印发《关于加强智能体终端设备进网管理的通知》
articles.summary: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) issued a notice strengthening network access management for intelligent agent terminal devices. The regulation marks an important step in China's governance of AI-powered edge devices and agent-capable hardware.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire AI agent security startup Clutch for approximately $500 million, representing a roughly 6x step-up from Clutch's last known valuation of $85 million. The deal would signal major cybersecurity incumbents moving urgently to defend against and secure the growing attack surface created by autonomous AI agents.

articles.title: Democrats planning flood of AI bills when they take control of Congress - Reuters
articles.summary: Democratic lawmakers are preparing a large package of AI-related legislation to advance when they regain control of Congress. This signals a potential shift toward more active federal AI governance and could reshape the regulatory landscape for AI development and deployment in the US.

articles.title: Nvidia Boosts Chip Tracking in Southeast Asia to Fight Smuggling
articles.summary: Nvidia is intensifying tracking measures for AI chips sold in Southeast Asia to prevent smuggling to Chinese entities following criticism of inadequate enforcement. This move highlights ongoing geopolitical tensions around semiconductor export controls and the difficulty of enforcing US restrictions on advanced AI hardware.

articles.title: China's chip equipment makers ride record AI orders into 2027, but new challenges lie ahead
articles.summary: China's domestic chip equipment manufacturers are experiencing record AI-driven orders projected to extend into 2027, though they face emerging technical and geopolitical challenges. This growth reflects China's accelerating effort to build a self-sufficient semiconductor supply chain amid ongoing Western export restrictions.

articles.title: Tesla unveils AI accelerator roadmap, adopts new 'SI' branding in 'Super Intelligence' push
articles.summary: Tesla has revealed an AI accelerator roadmap featuring its Dojo D3 training chip and a large SI6 inference accelerator, rebranding its AI ambitions under a new 'Super Intelligence' (SI) identity. This signals Tesla's intent to compete directly in custom AI silicon, reducing reliance on third-party chips and potentially entering the broader AI infrastructure market.

articles.title: 99.4%登顶全球第一！这个中国AI师承世界冠军
articles.summary: A Chinese AI system has reportedly topped a global ranking with a 99.4% score, described as having learned from a world champion. The achievement signals continued competitive progress in Chinese AI benchmarking and specialized model training.
